output: Source [4] (study, 2009) says the mass of the solar based system for the commuter option was over 22,000 kg for a 25 kWe system, including a dust storm survival array, while Source [4] (study, 2009) also says the nuclear power system mass was approximately 8,000 kg for a 30 kWe system including above ground shield and deployment cart.
